description: update-agent-guard.yml and update-sessidx.yml bump the formulae with bump-formula-pr, whose pull requests also build and publish bottles, so Renovate updates only the workflows.
platformAutomerge stays false so that automerge never depends on which checks main requires: Renovate merges once every check on the pull request passes.

customManagers.description: Read Homebrew Actions' four-part calendar tags without truncating the version.

packageRules.description: The github-actions manager truncates Homebrew Actions' tags to three parts, a tag that does not exist, so only the custom manager above updates them.
GitHub runner versions have no release timestamps, so the cooldown applies to tagged actions.
Group and automerge non-major updates after checks pass.

test-bot runs these on every pull request, so their majors merge once checks pass. Homebrew/actions also supplies the steps that push bottles, and the other actions and runners run only when a release is bumped or published; no Renovate pull request exercises those.
